_schema.vehicle: {make, model, year, engine, market} -- the car this catalogue was compiled for

items[].id: stable row id; the per-VIN checklist status is keyed by it (required)
items[].kind: tsb | recall | csn | campaign | extended_warranty | emissions
items[].number: bulletin/recall number exactly as the rest of CUORE spells it (dossier tsb_matches, knowledge.py) -- cross-links match on it
items[].title: short title
items[].date: ISO date, or null when the repo has none
items[].summary: what it is for, in plain words
items[].condition: the symptom/condition the bulletin addresses, or null
items[].remedy: what the dealer/mechanic does, or null
items[].links: [{label, url}] or null when no link is on file
items[].applies: yes | no | vin_check -- does it apply to this car
items[].source: where the facts in this row came from
items[].verified: true when the source document itself was read; false when only indexed/inferred

_schema.notes: Extra fields are tolerated and passed through; only id is required. Merge steps append rows to items[] and must keep ids unique. cuore_relevance, applies_to, transport_canada_id and similar extras are optional and ignored by the template.

items.title: Flash: Powertrain Diagnostic and System Improvements (NHTSA copy is REV. D, Giulia-only)
items.summary: The bulletin the project cited as the basis for the ECM-calibration verdict. The NHTSA copy (10216318) is REV. D and covers the 2017 Alfa Romeo GIULIA 2.0L I4 DI Turbo (EC2) built on or before 2017-06-29 only; Stelvio is NOT listed in the opened document and no Stelvio copy of 18-030-17 was found. Applicability to this car is unconfirmed, check by VIN/dealer. The directly applicable 2018 Stelvio ECM flash bulletin is 18-026-20, which lists P1CEA/P24D6 but not P0440/P0455/P0456.
items.condition: MIL on with one or more listed DTCs (incl. P0455, P0456, P0440, P0441, P1CEA, P24D6); also misfire when cold, stall on restart after refuelling, idle stability.
items.remedy: Reprogram ECM with latest software via wiTECH 2 (charger 13.2-13.5 V, flash about 9 min), run ECM Misc Functions Phonic Wheel Replacement (otherwise P1300 stays active), clear DTCs. Labour 18-19-06-SK inspect 0.2 h; 18-19-06-TW inspect and reprogram 0.4 h. Also RRT 17-043.
items.source: NHTSA PDF 10216318 opened in full (research 2026-10-15); earlier: docs/reference/TSB_CATALOGUE.md section 2; mes-log-mcp/mes/knowledge.py; mes-log-mcp/mes/ecm.py
items.applies_to: 2017 (GA) Giulia only, 2.0L I4 DI Turbo (EC2), built on or before 2017-06-29, NAFTA/LATAM. Stelvio NOT listed.
items.cuore_relevance: The bulletin the project cites for P0440/P0455/P0456 on the 2.0T, but the NHTSA copy is Giulia-only; the Stelvio counterpart found is 18-026-20 (no P0455/P0456 in its list). Stelvio applicability of 18-030-17 is unconfirmed; check by VIN.

items.title: EVAP small-leak verification requires wiTECH SLVT
items.summary: The Small Leak Verification Test (SLVT). A road test cannot confirm a small EVAP leak repair; the dealer's wiTECH SLVT procedure is the verification. Mode $06 is the only non-dealer route to the measured value. Applies to 2012-2023 Stellantis US gas vehicles with SLVT (Stelvio not named individually); supersedes 18-095-21 (which superseded 18-089-19). SLVT must run first to confirm a leak and again after any repair or component replacement, including PCM software updates.
items.condition: Confirming a small EVAP leak (P0456) repair.
items.remedy: Run the wiTECH Small Leak Verification Test after the repair.
items.source: docs/research/EVAP_STELVIO.md (bulletin number 1804823); docs/reference/TSB_CATALOGUE.md section 2; cuore/web/templates/dealer.html; NHTSA PDF 10236933 opened in full (research 2026-10-15)
items.cuore_relevance: The acceptance test for the EVAP job: SLVT pass is the proof of fix.

items.title: Hard to fill / EVAP canister flooded with fuel
items.summary: Hard-to-fill diagnostic tree. A vapour line disconnected inside the tank at the fuel delivery module (FDM) port floods the EVAP canister with liquid fuel (fuel, not water).
items.condition: Hard to fill; canister or recirculation line found with fuel in it.
items.remedy: Check the clean-air hose ESIM to EVAP filter, the EVAP filter, and the tank-to-canister vapour hose; if fuel is found, drop the fuel tank, remove the FDM lock ring, check the internal vapour line at the FDM port, and replace BOTH the vapour canister and the ESIM.
items.source: docs/research/EVAP_STELVIO.md (covers GU 18-24 and GA; PDF retrieved); docs/reference/TSB_CATALOGUE.md section 2
items.research_note_2026_10_15: A later research pass could not find 9100471 on NHTSA or via search, so nothing was re-opened; the earlier retrieval recorded in the source field stands. Not re-verified.

items.title: Flash: Powertrain Control Module (PCM) Updates
items.summary: Directly applicable 2018 Stelvio (GU) 2.0L I4 DI Turbo (EC2) ECM flash, North America. Lists P1CEA and P24D6 (EVAP pressure sensor family) but NOT P0455/P0456/P0440. Also: turbo coolant pump after-run update (turbo O-ring durability), S&S text change, better idle stability. Supersedes 18-103-19; also RRT 17-112. Another NHTSA copy: 10175165. Check the ECM software level before buying more EVAP parts.
items.condition: MIL on with listed DTCs; may fail state inspection after reset, driveability issues, cold misfire.
items.remedy: Reprogram ECM (about 8 min), wiTECH 2 Phonic Wheel Replacement, clear DTCs, confirm BCM on latest software. Labour 18-19-06-BF 0.4 h.
items.source: NHTSA PDF opened in full (research 2026-10-15, tsb_details.json)
items.cuore_relevance: Directly applicable 2018 Stelvio 2.0T ECM flash; covers P1CEA and P24D6 (EVAP pressure sensor) but not P0455/P0456/P0440, so check ECM software level before buying more EVAP parts.

items.title: Customer Satisfaction Notification W05 - Reprogram Powertrain Control Module (turbo oil-feed weep)
items.summary: PCM software on about 57,000 vehicles may not allow sufficient cooling time for the turbo oil feed, causing thermal stress on the feed line and eventual oil weep. Covers 2017-2019 Giulia and 2018-2019 Stelvio, 2.0L GME-T4 (EC2). Performed per VIN at the dealer; no parts. If it was done, the ECM was already reflashed in 2020.
items.condition: Turbo oil-feed line thermal stress and oil weep (PCM cooling-time logic).
items.remedy: 2018 Stelvio: reprogram PCM, PROXI Alignment, Phonic Wheel Replacement routine (2019 Stelvio also TCM). Labour 18-W0-51-81 inspect 0.4 h; 18-W0-51-82 reprogram PCM/proxy/phonic wheel 0.5 h; 18-W0-51-83 PCM+TCM (time not captured).
items.source: NHTSA PDF opened in full (research 2026-10-15, tsb_details.json)
items.cuore_relevance: Turbo oil-feed weep on the 2.0T; also means the ECM may already have been reflashed (ask history).

items.title: Flash: Transmission Control Module (TCM) Update
items.summary: 2018 Stelvio (GU) 2.0L EC2 TCM flash, North America. Improves 8HP shift quality; also includes the turbo coolant pump after-run update. Pair with ECM flash 18-026-20.
items.condition: MIL with P0002, P026E, P1066, P26E4, P2B61, P2BC1, U1008; shift quality.
items.remedy: Reprogram TCM (about 4 min), clear DTCs, verify PCM on latest software. Labour 18-19-05-MX 0.3 h.
items.source: NHTSA PDF opened in full (research 2026-10-15, tsb_details.json)
items.cuore_relevance: Only 8HP shift-quality software bulletin found for the 2018 Stelvio; pair with ECM flash 18-026-20.

items.summary: Predecessor of 18-048-23 (via 18-095-21): the wiTECH Small Leak Verification Test is mandatory for P0456. Applies to 2015-2020 FCA gas vehicles generally; Stelvio not named. Only partially opened.
items.remedy: Run the SLVT.

items.title: P0456/P0455 analysis with wiTECH SLVT (dealer case record)
items.summary: Dealer case record for P0456/P0455 set in the PCM on FCA gas vehicles (not model specific). Follow service diagnostics, run SLVT, smoke/air check if a leak is confirmed; keep the original gas cap fitted during the test (the EELD 8404 adapter o-ring may mask a leak). Only partially opened.
items.condition: P0456 or P0455 set in PCM.
items.remedy: Run SLVT; smoke/air check if a leak is confirmed; keep the original gas cap fitted.
items.source: NHTSA PDF partially opened (research 2026-10-15)
items.cuore_relevance: Gas cap caution matters when smoke testing.

items.title: Flash: PCM Updates (P1CEA) - later model years
items.summary: PCM reflash family for P1CEA Boost Side EVAP Purge Performance on 2.0L Stelvio, but for later model years only: 18-045-23 is 2019, 18-041-23 is 2022, 18-023-23 is 2023. NOT 2018. Shows EVAP-family codes on this engine are fixed by calibration, but not 2018-specific. Other NHTSA ids: 10241053 and 10248038 (18-023-23), 10236901 (18-041-23).
items.condition: MIL + P1CEA (plus coil P230x, P2AC0 or knock P0331 depending on bulletin).
items.remedy: PCM reprogram. 18-023-23 REV B labour 18-19-06-HE 0.2 h, 18-19-06-HF 0.4 h.
items.source: NHTSA PDF opened in full (research 2026-10-15, tsb_details.json)
items.cuore_relevance: Shows EVAP-family codes on this engine are fixed by calibration, but not 2018-specific.
